datasets.name: BTXRD: Bone Tumor X-ray Radiograph dataset
datasets.summary: First milestone dataset. Radiographs with image-level labels, tumor boxes/masks and clinical fields.
unresolved: patient grouping: dataset.xlsx has no patient or lesion id, and the paper says several views can show the same lesion
device per image (center and anatomic site are in dataset.xlsx)
label adjudication process
label errors: 2 byte-identical image pairs are labeled benign in one copy and normal in the other (IMG000591/IMG003456, IMG000707/IMG003346); 21 exact-duplicate pairs in total
overlap with other public bone X-ray sets

datasets.name: BreastMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
datasets.summary: Breast ultrasound, benign+normal vs malignant, preprocessed to small npz arrays. Good for fast pipeline tests.
datasets.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2, Scientific Data 2023; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.10519652; source: Al-Dhabyani et al. 2020
unresolved: MedMNIST splits may not respect patient grouping of the source dataset

datasets.name: PathMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
datasets.summary: Colorectal cancer histology tiles, 9 tissue classes (from NCT-CRC-HE-100K / CRC-VAL-HE-7K). 28px and 64px versions.
datasets.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Kather et al. 2019 (NCT-CRC-HE)
unresolved: tiles from the same slide/patient cannot be grouped from the npz alone

datasets.name: NoduleMNIST3D (MedMNIST v3 record)
datasets.summary: 3D lung nodule crops from LIDC-IDRI with benign/malignant labels derived from radiologist suspicion ratings (not pathology).
datasets.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Armato et al. 2011 (LIDC-IDRI)

datasets.name: LIDC-IDRI sample (3 CT series, more patients on request)
datasets.summary: Three pinned CT series for adapter smoke tests and DICOM ingestion; add whole patients' CT series as a seeded sample or by patient ID. Not an evaluation set: LIDC is in the MONAI lung bundle's training data.

datasets.name: DermaMNIST (MedMNIST v3 record)
datasets.summary: Dermatoscopic images from HAM10000, 7 diagnostic classes.
datasets.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2; Tschandl et al. 2018 (HAM10000)
unresolved: HAM10000 has multiple images per lesion; MedMNIST split may leak lesions across partitions

datasets.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task01 BrainTumour
datasets.summary: Multimodal brain MRI (FLAIR, T1w, T1gd, T2w) with tumor sub-region labels, derived from BraTS 2016/2017. For brain adapter testing only: overlaps BraTS 2018 training data of the MONAI bundle.
datasets.citation: Antonelli et al. 2022, The Medical Segmentation Decathlon, Nat Commun

datasets.name: MURA musculoskeletal radiographs
datasets.summary: Normal/abnormal upper-extremity studies. Abnormal is not cancer; possible representation/robustness research only.

datasets.name: LIDC-IDRI (full)
datasets.summary: 1,010 subjects / 244,527 DICOM images (~133 GB per archive). Suspicion ratings are not confirmed malignancy.

datasets.name: BraTS 2021 challenge data
datasets.summary: Brain tumor MRI segmentation challenge release; partitions and labels are release-specific.

datasets.name: PANDA prostate biopsy challenge
datasets.summary: 10,616 biopsies / 2,113 patients (published dev set). Group by patient.

datasets.name: CAMELYON16
datasets.summary: Lymph-node whole-slide images for metastasis research, fetched slide by slide from the public AWS bucket (about 1.9 GB per slide on average). Check encoder pretraining overlap.
unresolved: patient linkage between slides is not published; each slide is treated as its own group
the README lists 20 tumor slides whose annotations are not exhaustive

datasets.name: ISIC Archive
datasets.summary: Skin lesion images across many collections, fetched through the ISIC API v2 for a search you narrow (e.g. diagnosis_3:"Melanoma, NOS"). Only CC-0 and CC-BY images are offered; each image comes with its API metadata record.
datasets.license: per-image (CC-0 / CC-BY; CC-BY-NC excluded by the fetcher)
unresolved: patient_id/lesion_id are missing for many images; those images are treated as their own group, so same-patient images can still be split apart
images recur across ISIC challenge releases and HAM10000 (DermaMNIST)
the API's file sizes can lag the served image (ISIC_0911264, 2026-10-24) and there is no published checksum, so images are hashed on arrival (trust on first use)

datasets.name: TCGA (via GDC)
datasets.summary: 33 cancer types; molecular, clinical and slide data. Open vs controlled access differ.

datasets.name: TCGA-SARC whole-slide images (GDC open access)
datasets.summary: Sarcoma H&E slides (SVS) from the GDC, fetched case by case with publisher MD5s. Soft-tissue sarcoma, not primary bone tumors. About 1.2 GB per slide on average.
datasets.citation: TCGA Research Network, Cell 2017 (adult soft tissue sarcomas); https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/TCGA-SARC
unresolved: Diagnostic (FFPE) and Tissue (frozen) slides are mixed; pick by file name to restrict
many pathology foundation models were pretrained on TCGA slides; check encoder overlap before evaluating

datasets.name: Soft-tissue-Sarcoma (TCIA): FDG-PET/CT and MRI
datasets.summary: Extremity soft-tissue sarcoma patients with CT, MR, PET and RT structure sets; fetch whole patients as a seeded sample or by ID (about 190 MB per patient, uncompressed). Not primary bone tumors.
unresolved: ROI names inside the RTSTRUCT series have not been reviewed
outcome labels in INFOclinical_STS.xlsx and their reference standard not reviewed

datasets.name: CBIS-DDSM mammography (TCIA)
datasets.summary: Curated DDSM screening mammograms with ROI crops and masks; fetch whole patients as a seeded sample or by ID. 163 GB in total, so only subsets fit here.
unresolved: pathology reference standard per row not reviewed
31 participants cross the official mass/calc train/test split; a patient-level split must regroup them

datasets.name: BloodMNIST: normal peripheral-blood cell images
datasets.summary: Eight-way blood-cell morphology image dataset. This is not a structured CBC table, a leukemia classifier, or an established cancer-detection endpoint.
datasets.citation: Yang et al., MedMNIST v2, Scientific Data 2023; Acevedo et al., peripheral blood-cell dataset; https://medmnist.com/
unresolved: No structured CBC feature table or cancer outcome target is supplied by this image archive.
Patient/slide identities and independence require source review before medical evaluation.

datasets.name: LUNA16 lung nodule benchmark
datasets.summary: A lung nodule detection challenge using 888 CT scans selected from LIDC-IDRI. Its cases overlap that source.
unresolved: LUNA16 is derived from LIDC-IDRI, so the two cannot be treated as independent cohorts.

datasets.name: EMBED breast imaging dataset
datasets.summary: Emory breast imaging research data with patient, exam, and finding hierarchies; the open release is a subset of the full dataset.
unresolved: Use is subject to registration and the dataset’s research-use agreement.

datasets.name: National Lung Screening Trial (NLST)
datasets.summary: Lung screening trial data spanning low-dose CT, chest radiography, clinical outcomes, and pathology resources.
datasets.license: Terms vary by component; review source
datasets.access: mixed; proposal required for full CDAS access
unresolved: Some resources are public; full datasets and biospecimens require an approved proposal and agreements.

datasets.name: BraTS-PEDs pediatric brain tumor MRI
datasets.summary: A pediatric brain-tumor MRI collection in the project data inventory. Review the release, sequences, labels, and intended population.
unresolved: Collection counts are not a guarantee that every case has labels for every task.

datasets.name: Osteosarcoma-Tumor-Assessment histology
datasets.summary: Osteosarcoma histology tiles from four selected patients, a distinct task from bone X-ray analysis.
unresolved: Tiles from the same patient must stay grouped; four patients limit generalization.

models.name: ResNet-50 (timm a1, ImageNet-1k)
models.summary: Conventional pretrained image backbone; matched baseline for the bone X-ray frozen-encoder comparison.

models.name: DINOv2 ViT-B/14
models.summary: General self-supervised vision encoder; second non-medical baseline.

models.name: RAD-DINO (Microsoft)
models.summary: Radiograph encoder pretrained on chest X-rays; open alternative to MedSigLIP for the bone X-ray frozen-encoder arm. Chest-only pretraining: bone transfer is an open question.

models.name: BiomedCLIP PubMedBERT ViT-B/16
models.summary: Biomedical image-text encoder trained on PMC figure-caption pairs; zero-shot and embedding baseline across modalities.

models.name: MedCPT Query Encoder (NCBI)
models.summary: Biomedical query encoder for literature retrieval (pairs with medcpt-article-encoder).

models.name: MedCPT Article Encoder (NCBI)
models.summary: Biomedical article encoder for literature retrieval.

models.name: MONAI lung_nodule_ct_detection bundle (RetinaNet)
models.summary: 3D CT lung nodule detector. Detects nodule candidates; says nothing about malignancy.

models.name: MONAI brats_mri_segmentation bundle (SegResNet)
models.summary: 3D multimodal brain MRI tumor sub-region segmentation (TC/WT/ET). Outlines regions; not a histologic diagnosis.

models.name: Phikon (Owkin, ViT-B pathology)
models.summary: Small open pathology tile encoder; lets pathology work start without gated models.

models.name: MedSigLIP-448 (Google HAI-DEF)

models.name: MedGemma 4B instruction-tuned (Google HAI-DEF)

models.name: H-optimus-1 (Bioptimus)
